links.comparator_used: Same text with errors left uncorrected (clean MIMIC-III notes versus notes with 5%-20% artificially introduced errors; AACH notes at their native 8% error rate)
links.outcome: Machine learning AUROC across feature representations and models as textual error rate varied
links.effect: Performance was tolerant at error rates <10% and declined significantly at higher rates (≥10%). The AACH dataset had an 8% error rate and showed no major performance drop.
links.tradeoff: Mixtral correctly detected errors in only 63% of progress notes, and 17% of notes had a single token misclassified because of medical terminology.
links.quote: Under varying error rates (5%-20%, in 5% increments), feature representation performance was tolerant to lower error rates (<10%) but declined significantly at higher rates.

design_hint: LLM-based data quality correction of progress notes before model training
